subject: Intro & quick qualification for self-serve signup — scale, timeline, ops
messages:
From: Emma Pierce <emma@olive-labs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood — signed up and quick ask

Hi Nikhil,

I signed our team up for a trial on the Redwood hosted API earlier today and got the confirmation email. I lead product at Olive Labs — we're a mid-market health-tech company that processes clinical notes and redaction. A couple quick items before a demo:

- Primary use case: structured extraction + de-identification over clinical notes.
- Current volume: roughly 900k–1.2M tokens/day expected in steady state (spiky weekdays).
- Timeline: we'd like to run a short pilot within ~6 weeks and move to production in 3–4 months if things look good.

Two quick operational questions: do you support HIPAA-compatible private deployments / dedicated capacity, and what kind of latency should we expect at ~200 qps?

Happy to hop on a call if you need more context — my calendar is a bit open next week.

Thanks,
Emma Pierce
Head of Product, Olive Labs
emma@olive-labs.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Pierce <emma@olive-labs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — signed up and quick ask

Hi Emma — nice to meet you, and congrats on getting started with the trial. Monica (cc) is our solutions lead for healthcare customers; she'll be on the kickoff if we move forward. A few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the demo and confirm the right engagement path:

1) Data sensitivity & controls
- Will PHI be passed to the hosted API, or would you need a dedicated/private deployment (VPC/on-prem)?

2) Traffic shape
- You mentioned 900k–1.2M tokens/day. Can you share expected peak concurrent requests (qps) or peak tokens/minute? If unsure, a typical spike percentage helps (e.g., 3–4x baseline).

3) Request/response size and latency expectations
- Avg prompt length and expected gen length (tokens) per request? Target P95 latency?

4) Integration & timeline
- Who will own engineering integration on your side, and who should attend the technical portion of the call (SRE/Backend/ML Eng)?
- Confirm pilot goals and key success metrics for the 6-week pilot.

If it's easiest I can send a very short intake worksheet (2–3 fields) — attached — or we can take answers on the call. My Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro-30 — propose 30 min for a focused qual + scheduling.

Attachment: intake-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Proposed near-term windows I have: Tue/Wed mornings and Thu afternoon (PDT). If those don't work, suggest a couple slots and I'll match.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
SDR, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai
From: Emma Pierce <emma@olive-labs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — signed up and quick ask

Thanks, Nikhil — answers below and I've filled the quick worksheet inline.

1) Data sensitivity & deployment
- Yes, PHI will be in-scope. For the pilot we can use a dedicated instance with strict network controls; long-term we may require VPC/private.

2) Traffic shape
- Baseline: ~300 requests/min (avg) with peaks up to ~1,000 requests/min during daytime. Avg tokens per request: prompt ~80 tokens; expected model gen ~120 tokens.

3) Latency & infra expectations
- Target P95: <= 500ms for single-turn extraction calls. If you have numbers for Redwood Dedicated with A100-style hardware and batching, that'd be helpful.

4) Integration & timeline
- Owner: Tim Carter, backend lead (tim@olive-labs.com). He should be on the technical call. Pilot goals: accuracy > 92% extraction F1 on our eval set + end-to-end throughput to support peak traffic for 6 weeks.

Preferred demo times: Thu 2027-05-11 10:00–10:30 PDT or Fri 2027-05-12 09:00–09:30 PDT. Prefer Thu if possible.

Attachment: system-arch.png (png) — simple diagram of where Redwood would sit in our pipeline.

Cheers,
Emma
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Pierce <emma@olive-labs.com>, Tim Carter <tim@olive-labs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — signed up and quick ask

Great — appreciate the details and the diagram. Thu 2027-05-11 10:00 PDT works for us; I went ahead and scheduled a 30-min intro + technical qual. Calendar invite has been sent to your address (and Tim).

What we'll cover in the 30 min:
- 10 min: high-level fit, security/deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 15 min: technical deep dive (peak qps, latency, integration points) — Monica and Vivek will cover this
- 5 min: next steps & pilot plan (deliverables, timeline, success criteria)

Prep items: please attach a short eval sample (anonymized) or share a redaction-free subset if you can; that will help Monica/Vivek run a quick quality check post-call.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/987654 — I linked the contact and created a deal (OL-2027-0058).

Attachment: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (pdf) — short agenda for the call and what Monica/Vivek will need.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
SDR, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai
